text:
maria: Heads-up — Aurum Health wants a POC but asking whether to run on Hosted or Dedicated. They’ve got a finetuned 13B variant and want low-cost ops + HIPAA controls.

lee: quick checklist for decision: compliance (BYOK, audit logs), perf (p99 latency), cost delta for quantized model, onboarding artifacts, and whether custom kernels are used.

dylan: model artifact details from training: model.safetensors + tokenizer.json + training-metadata.yaml. They used q4_0 during distillation. Asking if we can import q4_0 directly into Dedicated.

anya: BYOK + HSM is supported on Dedicated; Hosted supports envelope encryption but not customer HSM. If they insist on HSM and non-provider keys, Dedicated or Private is required.

kevin: perf target from Aurum: p95 < 200ms, sustained 150 rps, spikes to 300 rps. Contexts typical: median 256 tokens, 99th 2200.

maria: thanks — the long tail 2.2k implies we should test prefix caching + KV sharding. infra note?

kevin: we'll need to reserve high-memory nodes for calls >2k, otherwise batching will blow latency. Recommend routing >1k to a high-memory pool and keep default pool for <1k.

lee: pricing question they wanted: how much cheaper if they keep q4_0 vs fp16 on Dedicated? Any published multiplier?

dylan: rough multipliers: q4_0 = 0.55x, q8 = 0.78x, fp16 = 1.0x. For reserved commits we can offer an additional 15% off list for 9-12 month contracts.

maria: contract terms — they want DPA + SOC2 + the option to review access logs for model artifacts. Legal ok?

anya: legal ok on standard DPA + SOC2 attestation. For log access we'll provide S3 access to artifact events and a monthly extract. BYOK means we don't have plaintext keys; ops can't decrypt models. Need to add BYOK responsibilities clause though.

kevin: one compatibility caveat: the q4_0 file uses a custom scale-array layout (training team did an experiment). If custom layout, we can re-quantize to our canonical layout but adds 2 business days. If they can export using standard layout, faster.

maria: can you add that to the preflight we send to them? Also ask for a small eval set (50 prompts) and stats on response lengths.

dylan: adding to checklist. Preflight snippet going out:
```
- artifacts: model.safetensors, tokenizer.json, config.json
- quant_format: q4_0 (standard layout preferred)
- sample_eval.json (50 prompts)
- prompt_length_hist.csv
- list of custom ops (if any)
```

kevin: infra-bot: created resource-check #RR-9743 for Dedicated pool sizing.

infra-bot: resource-check submitted (RR-9743). Owner: kevin. Expected ETA: 1 business day.

anya: security note — Aurum wants key rotation every 90 days and proof of rotation. Our BYOK docs show rotation process; we will provide rotation logs and KMS policies.

maria: operational plan proposal:
1) Artifact ingest to staging (day 0-1)
2) Compatibility & re-quant if needed (day 1-3)
3) Perf tuning: batching, KV namespace & high-mem routing (week 1)
4) Security review & DPA finalization (week 1-2)
5) POC run (4-6 weeks) with weekly checkpoints

lee: sounds good. If they go Hosted initially, we can still do the compatibility check in staging but HSM features won't be testable. Suggest Dedicated POC for final validation.

dylan: running local validate command now and will post results. Command:```python infra/validate_model.py --model s3://aurum/poc/model.safetensors --tok s3://aurum/poc/tokenizer.json --eval sample_eval.json```
Initial check: loads, tokenizer matches, eval perplexity ~2.5. No dimensional mismatches.

maria: perfect. Action owners: dylan -> run compat & post quant note, kevin -> confirm pool sizing and route config, anya -> draft BYOK + DPA addendum, lee -> prepare pricing one-pager with reserved-commit discount options.

kevin: note for sales: if they commit to 9mo reserved at scale X we can grant a free 2-week burst for POC traffic to mimic production spikes.

maria: Jordan from Aurum will upload the eval and confirm whether they prefer Hosted test or Dedicated POC. Jordan—please confirm and also whether custom ops were used.

jordan (Aurum, external): Uploading eval set now. No fused custom ops in the checkpoint. We did a custom quant tool but can export to standard q4_0. Prefer Dedicated POC to validate HSM + audit flows. NDA in place.

maria: thanks. We'll schedule a kick-off for Monday. Final reminder — ask training team to export q4_0 using standard layout to avoid re-quant delay. :+1:
